name: Manifesto Orbital station
desc:
A basic communist orbital station with standard issue defences, urban agricultural, industry, and housing.
Must be reduced before invasions or bombardment can be attempted.

name: Manifesto  Battlestation
desc:
A medium communist  space station made of by adding a hammer module onto a standard manifesto station.

It must be reduced before invasions or bombardment can be attempted.

name: Manifesto Star Fortress
desc:
A large communist space station made by adding a sickle module onto a manifesto class station.

It must be reduced before invasions or bombardment can be attempted.
